title: ISO 45001:2018 Readiness & Gap Assessment Checklist
subtitle: A practical checklist for assessing OH&S management system readiness against ISO 45001
intro: ISO 45001 certification depends on an occupational health and safety management system that actively prevents harm, not just documents intent. This checklist sets out a practical sequence for assessing OH&S maturity and closing gaps before certification or recertification audit.

sections.title: Context, Scope & Worker Participation
items: Define the OH&S management system scope, including sites and activities covered
Identify interested parties and their relevant OH&S expectations
Establish processes for worker consultation and participation
Confirm the scope statement is consistent with certification intent

sections.title: Leadership & OH&S Policy
items: Document an OH&S policy approved and communicated by top management
Assign OH&S roles, responsibilities, and authorities across the organisation
Set measurable OH&S objectives aligned to significant hazards and risks
Confirm management commitment through visible leadership and resourcing

sections.title: Hazard Identification & Risk Assessment
items: Maintain a hazard identification process covering routine and non-routine activities
Apply a documented OH&S risk assessment methodology consistently
Identify legal and other OH&S requirements applicable to the organisation
Evaluate compliance with legal requirements on a set frequency
Apply the hierarchy of controls when determining risk controls

sections.title: Operational Controls
items: Establish operating controls for activities associated with significant OH&S risks
Manage contractor and visitor safety through defined onboarding and controls
Maintain permit-to-work and change management processes for high-risk activities
Maintain emergency preparedness and response procedures and test them regularly

sections.title: Incident Management & Performance
items: Report and investigate incidents, near misses, and nonconformities consistently
Determine root cause and assign corrective actions with clear ownership
Track leading and lagging OH&S performance indicators
Monitor medical surveillance and occupational health data where applicable

sections.title: Internal Audit
items: Maintain an internal audit programme covering all OH&S clauses and significant risks
Assign auditors who are independent of the area being audited
Raise nonconformities with objective evidence and clear descriptions
Verify corrective actions close the root cause, not just the symptom

sections.title: Management Review
items: Hold management review at planned intervals with a defined agenda
Review incident trends, audit results, and compliance evaluation outcomes
Review worker consultation feedback and participation outcomes
Record decisions on resourcing, changes, and improvement opportunities

sections.title: Continual Improvement & Certification Readiness
items: Investigate OH&S nonconformities and verify effectiveness of corrective actions
Reassess risk after changes to operations, equipment, or legislation
Confirm evidence trails exist for training, PPE issue, and medical surveillance
Conduct a pre-certification readiness review ahead of the external audit
